pages.text: $(bold)Rainbow Lamp$() adds a single full-bright lamp whose $(bold)colour follows the redstone signal$() feeding it — strengths 0 to 15 map to the sixteen dye colours.$(br2)Feed it a steady signal and it holds that colour; wire it to a changing input — a comparator, a clock — and it shifts. Equal parts decoration and a readout you can see across the room.
pages.title: Rainbow Lamp

pages.text: $(bold)Crafting$() — see $(italic)EMI$(). The full wiring side — and every other lamp and sensor in the pack — lives in the $(italic)Redstone Catalogue$().
pages.title: Wiring It
